newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil suspends rail concession auction - bourse.
newsitem.headline: Brazil suspends rail concession auction - bourse.

text.p: The Parana Stock Exchange said today's auction of a 30-year concession to operate the cargo services of a 250-km (150-mile) railway in the southern state of Parana was suspended.
The auction, scheduled for 3 p.m. (noon EDT/1700 GMT), was suspended following a court injunction preventing the sale, a bourse spokesman said.
The spokesman could not give further details.
The Ferroeste railway, which links the cities of Cascavel and Guarapuava in Parana state, was due to be auctioned off for a minimum price of 25.6 million reais.
